ingredients.title: Sauté
items: 1 lb beef chunks or stew meat

instructions.title: Sauté
items: Set instant pot to sauté and add olive oil
Add carrots, then onion. Sauté for 2-3 minutes (can sauté at the same time as browning the beef)
Add beef chunks and brown on all sides
Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds

instructions.title: Pressure cook
items: Add beef broth and scrape the bottom of the pot to deglaze
Pressure cook on high for 10-11 minutes
Quick release pressure after time is up
Cook longer for more tender meat, but also more mushy vegetables.
